title: Djembe Bare-Bones Starter Packet
build_target: stave-built djembe evidence map and validation starter
artifact_focus: bare-bones packet for djembe acoustics evidence, construction decisions, and validation gates
cad_dxf_status: future authority unless reviewed geometry is promoted

validation_loop.authority_note: Rows define the next measurement or review action; they do not make the packet empirically validated.

required_before_public: Record repeatable mic/FFT strike measurements for bass, open tone, and slap.
Select one construction path before cut lists or jig drawings are treated as actionable.
Promote reviewed CAD, DXF, drawing, or design-table authority before fabrication geometry claims.
Verify BOM sources, dimensions, and safety factors at purchase and build time.
Document head material, head diameter, rope/ring hardware, and tuning state for any acoustic claim.
Validate visual-output-register.csv whenever new photos, scans, renders, or generated images are added.

readiness_ladder.next: shop packet candidate after strike measurements and geometry authority gates
readiness_ladder.not_yet: build-ready family, L2 bench-validated, or empirically validated packet

notes: Existing FEM analysis is analysis evidence only, not physical drum validation.
Existing photos and scans support provenance and documentation, not dimensional authority by themselves.
The visual-output register currently records reference-only artifacts; no row controls fabrication dimensions.
Supplier, price, and availability information is intentionally unverified in this starter packet.
